description: Service-level live validation profiles for moving curated high-frequency services from planner/readback coverage toward live-validated curated evidence.

profile_contract.planner_boundary: The planner must not execute hcloud, probe networks, create resources, import Terraform state, or read secrets.

hcloud_readback_operations.purpose: Discover servers in the selected region/project.
Collect bounded server inventory and status evidence.
Read back target status, flavor, image, addresses, security groups, and metadata.
Read back NIC, subnet, and port linkage.
Read back attached boot/data disks.

acceptance_evidence.description: ShowServer proves the target server exists and records ACTIVE/ERROR/SHUTOFF state, addresses, flavor, image, and security group linkage.
For create/rebuild/resize flows, job terminal success must be captured separately from later resource readiness.
Guest-level readiness such as SSH, COC, or application process checks must stay separate from ECS ACTIVE.
User-facing application readiness requires a bounded HTTP/TCP probe or equivalent application health evidence.

probe_candidates.description: HTTP/HTTPS health URL through the intended user path.
TCP reachability to the approved application or admin port.

promotion_gates.description: Target server readback is captured from hcloud.
Async job evidence is present when a job is part of the flow and is not reported as business readiness by itself.
A protocol or application path has been verified when the task claims user-facing readiness.

blockers: No live validation without isolated account/project and approved target IDs.
Do not collect or print SSH private keys or passwords.

hcloud_readback_operations.purpose: Discover VPCs in the selected region/project.
Discover subnets and CIDR boundaries.
Discover security group inventory.
Discover current ingress/egress rules.
Read back the target VPC.
Read back the target subnet when subnet scope matters.
Read back the target security group.
Read back the exact security group rule.

acceptance_evidence.description: Read back the target VPC and, when relevant, subnet CIDR/AZ/gateway evidence.
Read back direction, protocol, port range, source CIDR, and target attachment context.
Verify the intended ECS, EIP, or ELB path from the approved source and expected protocol/port.

probe_candidates.description: HTTP/HTTPS probe for the network path affected by the rule.
TCP probe to the intended target after rule readback.

promotion_gates.description: Cloud-side network and rule state are read back.
Source CIDR is explicit and sensitive ports are not opened broadly.
Network change claims are backed by a target path probe when reachability is the user goal.

blockers: Do not open SSH/Web common ports to 0.0.0.0/0 automatically.
Shared security groups require attachment impact review before change claims.

hcloud_readback_operations.purpose: Discover EIP inventory, binding, status, and idle candidates.
Read back public IP address, bandwidth, status, and binding target.
Read back bandwidth policy when bandwidth cost or throttling is in scope.

acceptance_evidence.description: Read back public IP status, address, bandwidth, billing mode, and current binding target.
Verify the exact ECS port, ELB, NAT, or other target resource that owns the EIP binding.
Probe the expected public protocol through the EIP after security group evidence is collected.
Record whether idle or unbound EIP resources still incur retention/bandwidth cost.

probe_candidates.description: HTTP/HTTPS probe through the EIP-backed entry path.
TCP probe to an approved public port after CIDR review.

promotion_gates.description: EIP status and binding are read back.
Public entry readiness is paired with binding and protocol evidence.
Idle/unbound cost posture is not inferred from resource status alone.

blockers: Do not report an EIP as reachable from ShowPublicip alone.
Release/unbind remains a separate explicitly approved teardown action.

hcloud_readback_operations.purpose: Discover OBS bucket inventory through the OBS adapter.
Read back target bucket metadata and existence.
Read back lifecycle policy before retention claims.
Read back bucket policy and public exposure posture.

acceptance_evidence.description: Read back bucket stat, policy, lifecycle configuration, and public-access posture through the OBS adapter.
Verify index/error documents, object availability, CDN/DNS linkage, or HTTP/HTTPS response for published content.
Record owner, data classification, lifecycle retention, and public access justification.

probe_candidates.description: HTTP/HTTPS probe for the website endpoint, object URL, custom domain, or CDN URL.

promotion_gates.description: Published website/object claims are backed by HTTP evidence.
Lifecycle and public access posture is explicitly reviewed.

blockers: OBS adapter may need obsutil-specific endpoint/config; do not assume normal hcloud profile covers it.
Do not dump object listings or policy secrets into chat.

hcloud_readback_operations.purpose: Discover load balancer inventory and status.
Discover listener topology.
Discover backend pool topology.
Read back target load balancer status and networking.
Read back listener protocol, port, certificate linkage, and defaults.
Read back pool protocol and health policy.
Read back backend members.
Read back a target backend member.

acceptance_evidence.description: Read back load balancer, listener, pool, member, and health monitor topology.
Verify backend member health, backend ECS status, and security group allowance from the ELB subnet.
Probe HTTP/TCP through the ELB entry point with expected host, path, port, and status behavior.

probe_candidates.description: HTTP/HTTPS probe through the ELB listener.
TCP probe to the listener when HTTP is not applicable.

promotion_gates.description: ELB listener/pool/member topology is read back.
Backend health evidence is present before traffic readiness claims.
User-path traffic has been probed through the ELB entry point.

blockers: Do not declare ELB ready from listener or pool creation alone.
Backend ECS security groups must allow ELB health-check and service traffic.

hcloud_readback_operations.purpose: Discover database instances and lifecycle status.
Discover backup posture.
Discover available parameter groups.
Read back backup policy for the target instance.
Read back parameter group detail when config scope is known.
Read back target instance configuration and pending restart context.

acceptance_evidence.description: Read back instance state, backup policy, configuration/parameter state, endpoint, and pending restart state.
Run a bounded connection probe from the intended client network with least-privilege credentials.
Record latest backup posture, maintenance window, restart impact, and rollback owner before risky changes.

probe_candidates.description: TCP database-port reachability from an approved client source; never collect database passwords in chat.

promotion_gates.description: RDS instance, backup, and parameter evidence is read back.
Application/client connection path is verified without exposing credentials.
Backup, restart, and rollback boundaries are reviewed before risky claims.

blockers: Do not ask the user to paste database passwords.
Available instance state does not prove application connectivity.
